Assume that X and Y are two independent Random variables with probability distribution function f_X(x; η, β) and f_Y(x; ψ, δ). Differentiating with respect to x, ∂log[Λ]/∂x = ... Hence, [∂log[Λ]/∂x] < 0, if η < ψ, β < δ.
